sourceFamilies.label: U.S. Access Board
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States federal accessibility guidance context; project adoption and local code still require confirmation.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for accessibility guidance and standards landing pages; avoid universal compliance claims without adopted-code context.

sourceFamilies.label: Whole Building Design Guide / NIBS
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States federal/public guidance context; not a substitute for project-specific codes or professional judgment.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for design guidance and interdisciplinary building performance topics. Accepted resource links should describe WBDG as contextual guidance, not a primary standard.

sourceFamilies.label: buildingSMART International
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: International/open BIM standards context; project deliverables still require contract-specific requirements.
sourceFamilies.notes: Good source family for IFC/openBIM entities and documentation.

sourceFamilies.label: American Society of Civil Engineers
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States model standard context; adoption depends on IBC/state/local jurisdiction and edition.
sourceFamilies.notes: Landing pages are not a substitute for the standard text; keep code-like links needs_review unless edition/section context exists.

sourceFamilies.label: American Concrete Institute
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States model concrete standard context; adoption and edition must be confirmed.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use edition/section-specific context for accepted rule-like links.

sourceFamilies.label: American Institute of Steel Construction
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States steel design and construction context; adoption and edition must be confirmed.
sourceFamilies.notes: Strong source for steel design/manual references; verify accessible landing pages before accepted links.

sourceFamilies.label: Institution of Structural Engineers
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: UK professional-body context; check project jurisdiction before governance claims.
sourceFamilies.notes: Useful for structural guidance and professional practice materials.

sourceFamilies.label: Institution of Civil Engineers
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: UK professional body; many educational resources are broadly useful but not universal code authority.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for professional education and civil/structural engineering guidance with context caveats.

sourceFamilies.label: Royal Institute of British Architects
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: UK architectural professional context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for architecture/professional-practice references with scope caveats.

sourceFamilies.label: American Institute of Architects
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States architectural professional context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for architectural professional practice and contract/process resources.

sourceFamilies.label: Federal Highway Administration
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States federal transportation context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Strong for transportation/geotechnical infrastructure; map generic building nodes carefully.

sourceFamilies.label: National Institute of Building Sciences
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: United States public-interest building science context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Includes WBDG/NIBS materials; may overlap with wbdg_nibs.

sourceFamilies.label: International Organization for Standardization
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: International standard context; implementation depends on contracts, national adoption, and edition.
sourceFamilies.notes: Public landing pages should not be treated as full standard text.

sourceFamilies.label: Uniclass / NBS
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: UK classification context with broader industry use.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for classification references rather than technical design governance.

sourceFamilies.label: OmniClass / CSI
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: North American construction classification context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for classification and specification taxonomy references.

sourceFamilies.label: Crossref
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Identifier/metadata discovery provider only.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use to verify DOI metadata; not content authority by itself.

sourceFamilies.label: OpenAlex
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Academic discovery metadata context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Candidate discovery provider; verify actual source/publisher before accepting.

sourceFamilies.label: Semantic Scholar
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Academic discovery metadata context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Candidate discovery provider; verify paper metadata and access.

sourceFamilies.label: DataCite
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Identifier/metadata discovery provider only.
sourceFamilies.notes: Useful for dataset DOI metadata checks.

sourceFamilies.label: CORE
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Open-access discovery/aggregation context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Verify repository and publisher metadata before acceptance.

sourceFamilies.label: Unpaywall
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Open-access availability metadata context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Use for OA status, not as final source authority.

sourceFamilies.label: Open Library
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Book metadata discovery only.
sourceFamilies.notes: Candidate metadata discovery provider; not final content authority by itself.

sourceFamilies.label: Google Books
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Book metadata and preview discovery context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Verify publisher/ISBN metadata; preview availability is not content authority.

sourceFamilies.label: Internet Archive
sourceFamilies.jurisdiction: Public digital-library metadata and lending/access context.
sourceFamilies.notes: Verify rights/access status before indexing full text.

sourceFamilies.label: General web
sourceFamilies.notes: Candidate only; rarely top-ranked without stronger review.
